calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-07-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald J. Sullivan, Clerk: S. Vantree, CSR: Sonia Wong #11288.

Petitioner Monica Yumang present in pro per, placed under oath and examined.

Case was called and then put over to later in the morning for the petitioner to return with proof of residency in San Francisco.

The case was recalled at 10:30. Petitioner provided the court with a bank statement from her bank that indicated her address is located the the city of San Francisco.

Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to Monica Razon.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
